holder_name: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited
title: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited receives 3.6M CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust units as management fees
body: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited received 3,617,106 units of CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust as payment of management fees, valued at S$2.252 per unit, or S$8,145,722 in total. Total interest rises from 91,177,251 units (1.14%) to 94,794,357 units (1.18%).
remarks_text: Notes to this Part II - Transaction Details (1) In relation to Table 1 of item 8 of Transaction A, the percentage of total number of units held "Immediately before the transaction" is based on 7,974,048,554 units in CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust ("CICT", and units in CICT, "Units") as at 11 September 2026 (being the last change in the total number of Units), and the percentage of total number of units held "Immediately after the transaction" is based on 7,977,665,660 Units as at 23 November 2026 following the issuance of Units in respect of Transaction A. (2) The percentages are rounded down to the nearest 0.01%. (3) Please refer to item 12 in respect of Transaction B below for further details in relation to Transaction A.
change_reason: the issuance of Units in respect of Transaction A

holder_name: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited
title: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited sells S$8.1M of CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust units received as management fees
body: CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust Management Limited sold 3,617,106 units of CapitaLand Integrated Commercial Trust received as management fees at S$2.252 per unit, for a total of S$8,145,722. Total interest falls from 94,794,357 units (1.18%) to 91,177,251 units (1.14%).
remarks_text: Notes to this Part II - Transaction Details (1) In relation to Table 1 of item 8 of Transaction B, the percentage of total number of units held "immediately before the transaction" and "Immediately after the transaction" is based on 7,977,665,660 Units as at 23 November 2026 following the issuance of Units in respect of Transaction A. The percentage are rounded down to the nearest 0.01%. (2) In relation to item 7 of Transactions A and B, CICTML is entitled to receive 3,617,106 Units at an issue price of $2.2520 per Unit as payment of 50.0% of the base component of the management fee for the period from 1 July 2026 to 30 September 2026 (both dates inclusive) in relation to the management of investments (including properties) that are held by CICT and/or its subsidiaries. (3) CICTML has sold the 3,617,106 Units which it is entitled to receive, to Premier Healthcare Services International Pte Ltd ("Premier"), a related corporation of CICTML, and in connection with the sale, CICTML has directed that such Units be issued directly to Premier instead of CICTML.

title: Pang Yoke Chun's deemed interest in Tai Sin Electric Ltd rises after purchase of 523K shares

deemed_interest_text: Mdm. Pang Yoke Chun is deemed to have an interest in 78,604,396 shares held by her husband, Mr. Lim Boon Hock Bernard.
remarks_text: The percentage of shareholding immediately before and after the transaction is calculated based on the Company's number of issued ordinary shares (excluding treasury shares) of 460,261,841 shares as at 23 November 2026. title: Ravinder Sajwan buys S$72,609 of Ultragreen Ai Ltd shares
body: Ravinder Sajwan bought 156,800 shares of Ultragreen Ai Ltd in a market transaction at S$0.4631 per share, for a total of S$72,609. Total interest rises from 686,139,154 shares (62.45%) to 686,295,954 shares (62.46%).
deemed_interest_text: The business and affairs of IR Investments LP are managed by a board of managers (the “IR Board of Managers”). IR Holding Company Inc., the general partner of IR Investments LP, has on 15 December 2019 appointed Mr Sajwan as the sole and initial member of the IR Board of Managers. Mr Sajwan is also a Protector of The Saul Trust and a member of Saul Strategic Limited (which holds 100% of Saul Holdings Pte. Ltd.’s ordinary shares). Accordingly, for the purposes of the Securities and Futures Act 2001 of Singapore and the Securities and Futures (Disclosure of Interests) Regulations 2012, Mr Sajwan has a deemed interest in the Shares held by Renew Group Private Limited.
remarks_text: THE PERCENTAGE IN SHAREHOLDING IS CALCULATED BASED ON THE ISSUED SHARE CAPITAL OF 1,098,647,200  SHARES, EXCLUDING TREASURY SHARES, AS AT 20 NOVEMBER 2026.

title: Bibace Management Pte Ltd becomes substantial shareholder of Banyan Tree Holdings Ltd with 33.05% stake
body: Bibace Management Pte Ltd's deemed interest in Banyan Tree Holdings Ltd moved from 0.00% to 33.05% following a transfer of shares. No shares are held directly. Total interest rises from 0 shares (0.00%) to 286,519,882 shares (33.05%). With this, the holder becomes a substantial shareholder of Banyan Tree Holdings Ltd.
deemed_interest_text: Bibace Investments Ltd("BI") is an existing substantial shareholder of Banyan Tree Holdings Limited (BTH") through BTH shares held by its nominee, HSBC (Singapore) Nominees Pte Ltd. Bibace Management Pte Ltd ("BMPL”), acting as trustee of The Bibace Trust after the transfer, has a deemed interest in the 286,519,882 BTH shares in which BI has an interest.
change_reason: the transfer of all voting shares in Bibace Investments Ltd to Bibace Management Pte Ltd
